function bakeTraversalField(data, width, height, cells): void

Defined in: website/components/media/draw-text/traversal.ts:94

bakeTraversalField — floods each cell's ink from its pen-entry point and writes the normalized visit order into the atlas' R channel, in place. Pixels the flood cannot reach keep their painted R=255 so they write last (pen lift) or never (paper — alpha masks them out anyway).

The bucket queue is a bounded drain loop, not stack emulation: each pixel is enqueued at most once per relaxation and dist strictly decreases per re-push, so the ring always empties.
